# START-BUILD — how a build session begins (read this first)

Spec is **FROZEN v1.0 (2026-08-17)**. Every build session follows this order:

1. **Orient (5 min):** `CLAUDE.md` → this file → `docs/build/00-build-plan.md` (find the current slice; its acceptance criteria are the target) → `docs/build/_registry.md` (names/IDs — use verbatim) → the sections of `01–05` the slice cites → `DESIGN.md` for anything visible → `docs/build/06-decisions/` (accepted ADRs amend the specs).
2. **Run the foreman:** invoke the **`build-phase`** skill with the slice ID. It restates scope, orders the work, and pulls in the specialists: `supabase-ops` (schema/RLS/auth/storage), `backend-robustness` (jobs/actions/adapters), `web-quality` (how UI is engineered), `design-fidelity` (how it looks), `security-check`, `vercel-ops` (env/cron/deploy), `test-engineer` (harness/tests). Skills follow `docs/skill-handoffs.md` (owns / hand-off note / stop-and-ask).
3. **Branch per slice:** `feat/<slice-id>-<slug>` (e.g. `feat/S0-scaffold`). One PR per slice; PR body per 00 §1.3 (slice ID, spec sections, `## ADRs in this PR`, gate verdicts, screenshots, `## Bundle` if needed).
4. **Checkpoint — two sessions per slice (David, 2026-08-20):** Session A runs with ultracode ON and is the build pass only: steps 1–3, the build, local CI green (`pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && node scripts/check-bundle-secrets.mjs && E2E=1 pnpm test:e2e`), commit, push the branch (+ fast-forward `staging`, ADR-0010), open the PR with the 00 §1.3 body. Then **STOP — do not spawn gates** (even with context to spare) — and print the checkpoint: "Build pass complete for S<x>. Turn ultracode off (`/config`), start a new session, paste: <Session-B prompt>". Session B runs with ultracode OFF and owns steps 5–8: gates → fixes (one round per ❌; a second ❌ on the same item → ask David) → David tries the preview and says "merge" → flip the PR's ADRs to Accepted → squash-merge → tag → verify production → close-out (docs, memory) → print the next slice's Session-A prompt. Never run gates in the same session as the build pass.
5. **Gates before merge — spawn the agents in one background batch** (`.claude/agents/`): `spec-drift-reviewer` (always), `design-fidelity-reviewer` + `frontend-reviewer` (UI touched), `security-reviewer` (auth/uploads/webhooks/comments/admin), `backend-reviewer` (server code), `supabase-reviewer` (`supabase/` touched); `deploy-checker` on the preview URL after deploy. Paste each `GATE:` verdict into the PR. Nothing merges with an open ❌; a second ❌ on the same item → stop and ask David.
6. **Deviations:** anything not matching `00–05`/`DESIGN.md`/`data-model` → ADR (`06-decisions/ADR-TEMPLATE.md`) + doc edit in the same PR. Never decide-and-move-on silently.
7. **Ship:** preview → PR → gates → merge (`main` auto-deploys to Vercel production — **public on odsens.com since the S1.1 merge; apex is primary and `www` 308s to it since 2026-09-06**: Deployment Protection (Standard) guards `*.vercel.app` URLs and previews, not the attached custom domain). Tag `v0.<n>` per slice.
8. **Close the slice:** acceptance criteria demonstrated on the preview, docs/`questions.md` updated (`keep-docs`), phase report posted, next slice named.

Environment facts: repo linked to Vercel project `odsens` (studiobing) and Supabase project `odsens` (`dllbekulbimblrsrxuyv`, Google auth configured via `supabase config push`); env vars seeded in Vercel; local `.env` from `.env.example` (David holds secrets); tooling per `docs/dev-tooling.md` (pnpm, Supabase CLI + OrbStack, Playwright). Staging = Supabase Branching (set up in S0/S1.10 with the GitHub + Vercel integrations).

Current position (2026-09-18): S0–S1.5a merged (`v0.6.1`) + three fix passes from Oliver's first and second use (ADR-0034, ADR-0035, ADR-0038), S1.5c — Project editor v2 (`v0.6.2`, PR #21, ADR-0039 / ADR-0040), and **S1.5b — Support page merged (`v0.6.3`, PR #23, ADR-0036 / ADR-0041), live on odsens.com**. A Support fix pass followed the same day (ADR-0042, branch `fix/support-one-button`, no tag): the amount picker is gone and one TIP ON KO-FI button swaps the gold card for Ko-fi's panel. **Next: S1.6 — Videos** (00 §2, as written; its Session A also moves Latest videos + Find me into the Home row beside the compact `TipPanel` — ADR-0041 D6). Two fix passes are queued and block nothing: the S1.5c follow-ups and the S1.5b follow-ups (`docs/questions.md`, under those names). The order and the reasons are in ADR-0036; Oliver's list and every disposition are in `docs/questions.md` "Oliver's first-use list (2026-09-11)". A session that starts a slice reads its 00 §2 section first.
